newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch cable TV operator A2000 wins phone licence.
newsitem.headline: Dutch cable TV operator A2000 wins phone licence.

text.p: Cable television operator A2000, a joint venture between Philips Electronics NV unit UPC and US West International, said on Monday it had won a licence to offer telephone services.

A2000, which has around 525,000 cable subscribers in the Amsterdam and Hilversum areas, said it would invest around 300 million guilders in "the next few years" to prepare the cable network for telephone and internet services.
In a separate announcement A2000 said it had reached agreement with Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (Dutch PTT) over interconnection between their two networks.

"With the finalisation of the interconnect agreement with PTT Telecom, A2000 will be able as planned to offer voice telephony to consumers and businesses in its area from July 1997," A2000 said in a statement issued jointly with Dutch PTT.
